target.title: ci(release): migrate macOS signing to OpenClaw Foundation [review-only]
target.body:
> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Review-only draft — do not merge.** The exact tree reached `main` as `476153ce54ca4b4fa31f92416fa143adb06aa768` and `d2e40082265b239db15f25ddc3cee032a607499e` before this PR could be created. This branch replays the patch from pre-change base `0867cd807e8ab4ba8dd428e2adc3114195f24b14` so the complete 29-file diff can be reviewed and discussed in one place. Any accepted fix should land as a separate follow-up PR from current `main`.

## Summary

- Remove the GitHub-hosted P12/certificate signing path and move official Darwin signing/notarization to a serialized local maintainer lane.
- Keep ordinary builds and GitHub CI credential-free. GitHub may verify immutable prebuilt assets, but never receives Apple signing or notary credentials.
- Preserve Gog's Mach-O identifier `com.steipete.gogcli.gog` while migrating the signer to `Developer ID Application: OpenClaw Foundation (FWJYW4S8P8)`.
- Prepare the patch release metadata for v0.33.1.

## v0.33.0 public-asset audit

- Signer: `Developer ID Application: Peter Steinberger (Y5PE65HELJ)`
- Team ID: `Y5PE65HELJ`
- Identifier: `com.steipete.gogcli.gog`
- Architectures: thin `x86_64` and thin `arm64`
- Notarization: absent; online notarization verification fails
- Designated requirement:

```text
identifier "com.steipete.gogcli.gog" and anchor apple generic and certificate 1[field.1.2.840.113635.100.6.2.6] /* exists */ and certificate leaf[field.1.2.840.113635.100.6.1.13] /* exists */ and certificate leaf[subject.OU] = Y5PE65HELJ
```

- Darwin archive SHA-256:
  - amd64: `259c4bf1f41bc725936eb816aac9d5c95df9eaf21be0a8df93a9c42fe55f83a4`
  - arm64: `d73b324fa3a35a08175432761c8bfd410896b1a22365aa89890ac4fbfdf7c66e`
- Homebrew path: `openclaw/homebrew-tap/Formula/gogcli.rb`, installed as `openclaw/tap/gogcli`, using the release archives directly

## Identity migration impact

The identifier remains stable. The Team-bound OU necessarily changes from `Y5PE65HELJ` to `FWJYW4S8P8`, so the exact designated requirement cannot remain identical. Existing Keychain ACL entries may need one authorization or ACL refresh. The release checklist therefore requires a controlled v0.33.0-to-v0.33.1 A/B Keychain test and a second v0.33.1 run before claiming continuity.

## Release contract

- `.github/workflows/release.yml` is now read-only and snapshot-only.
- `.github/workflows/post-release-bump.yml` is removed; a tag cannot publish or write `main` through the old path.
- `scripts/start-next-release.sh` is the sole serialized next-`Unreleased` writer.
- Regression tests reject the former certificate/P12 secret names and import patterns across tracked workflows/docs.
- `scripts/release-local` builds from a fresh clone pinned to protected default or the exact trusted signed tag.
- Native Go 1.26.5 and GoReleaser 2.17.0 producer archives are checksum-pinned for both host architectures.
- A clean environment is established before the canonical `release-mac-app` helper loads runtime material, followed by a second strict allowlist before GoReleaser executes.
- Draft creation receives a GitHub token only at its narrow boundary; pilot and verifier execution remain token-free.
- Seven-asset inventory, release notes, tag object/peeled commit, Team/identifier/designated requirement, notarization, checksums, independent Linux/Windows rebuilds, native Intel/Apple Silicon proof, and Homebrew recovery are all fail-closed.

## Validation

- `scripts/release-local --check`
- `make ci`
- `make worker-ci`
- `actionlint`
- ShellCheck and Python syntax checks
- `go mod verify`
- `govulncheck ./...`: zero reachable/imported vulnerabilities
- Worker dependency audit: no known vulnerabilities
- Gitleaks: changed/new files clean; full-tree findings are three unchanged dummy test fixtures
- Autoreview: clean, no accepted/actionable findings

Two consecutive credential-free v0.33.1 builds produced identical archive hashes:

```text
darwin_amd64  48b28c9d767b4a1b00dea2dc6f8a1205d97b06c53adbd877433e3a367b5756d8
darwin_arm64  894d93521a461fac256f6bf1faf67cd9586d9522e0fb3cfb338151d4e627fe7e
linux_amd64   9a681af4fb37eddcea1f3a232f42512e6c03b094880d91664227590d32d9235d
linux_arm64   1fef3a80a0c40e6a9ff42c0ff997ae0082308665febbd74b140b58c0dbf7eecd
windows_amd64 56157e38a0591f65b80b11e498ed245ccb60f55b19dd4c6c735d6444ccc0d4a5
windows_arm64 cd537dc2a7967d428b2cb942ce70952aacbfa0f8d660f922907bf76e187e983a
```

The local proof artifacts intentionally remain unsigned/ad-hoc and show `vcs.modified=true`; they are not publishable. The fresh signed-tag lane requires `vcs.modified=false`, Foundation signing, accepted notarization, exact two-architecture verifier proof, and downstream install checks.

## Remaining public gates

No tag, GitHub release, Homebrew update, Apple submission, Keychain use, or 1Password use was performed during preparation. After owner authorization and successful exact-head CI, the serialized sequence is:

1. `scripts/release-local pilot v0.33.1`
2. Create and push the signed annotated `v0.33.1` tag
3. Require exact-tag `ci` and read-only `release-check`
4. `scripts/release-local draft`
5. `scripts/release-local verify-draft v0.33.1`
6. `scripts/release-local publish v0.33.1`
7. `scripts/release-local homebrew v0.33.1`
8. Verify public downloads, notes, checksums, quarantined clean-VM Gatekeeper execution, controlled Keychain A/B behavior, and Homebrew install/test
9. Run `scripts/start-next-release.sh v0.33.1`, commit the v0.33.2 `Unreleased` state, push, and require clean exact-head CI

## Reviewer focus

- Identifier and designated-requirement continuity across the Team migration
- Complete removal of credential-bearing GitHub release paths
- Credential and token boundaries around local production and remote verification
- Exact tag/run/asset correlation and immutable-inventory checks
- Retry-safe publish and Homebrew recovery behavior
